name: @pipeworx/mcp-kroger

tools.name: kroger_store_locator
tools.description: Find Kroger-family grocery stores and supermarkets near a US ZIP code — covers Kroger, Ralphs, Fred Meyer, King Soopers, Fry's, Harris Teeter, QFC, Smith's, Dillons, Food 4 Less, Mariano's and more. Returns store names, addresses, phone, hours, and the location_id needed for price lookups. Example: kroger_store_locator({ zip_code: "45202" })

zip_code.description: US ZIP code to search near, e.g. "45202"

_apiKey.description: Optional: your own Kroger API credentials as "client_id:client_secret" (free at developer.kroger.com)

tools.name: kroger_product_search
tools.description: Search grocery products at Kroger-family supermarkets with real shelf prices, promo/sale prices, stock level, and aisle. Answers "how much does milk cost", "is X in stock", grocery price comparison. Give a zip_code (or location_id) to get store-specific prices; without one, only the national product catalog is returned (no prices). Example: kroger_product_search({ term: "whole milk", zip_code: "45202" })

term.description: Product search term, e.g. "whole milk", "cage free eggs", "diet coke 12 pack"

zip_code.description: US ZIP code — the nearest store is auto-selected so prices and stock appear

location_id.description: Exact store location_id from kroger_store_locator (overrides zip_code)

_apiKey.description: Optional: your own Kroger API credentials as "client_id:client_secret" (free at developer.kroger.com)

tools.name: kroger_product_details
tools.description: Get full detail for one grocery product by its product_id — price, promo price, stock level, size, categories, aisle location, images. Pass zip_code or location_id for store-specific price/stock. Example: kroger_product_details({ product_id: "0001111041700", zip_code: "45202" })

zip_code.description: US ZIP code — nearest store auto-selected for price/stock

_apiKey.description: Optional: your own Kroger API credentials as "client_id:client_secret"

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-kroger forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the kroger pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
